description: This file defines the MultipartUploader class within the Aws\S3 namespace, responsible for managing multipart uploads to Amazon S3 or Glacier. It includes methods for creating upload parts, handling sources, and managing upload workflow.

classes.name: MultipartUploader
classes.description: Handles multipart upload operations to S3 or Glacier, including creating, managing, and completing multipart uploads. Supports resumable uploads and custom configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartUploader with a client, source data, and configuration options.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Loads the workflow info parameters for initiating, uploading parts, and completing uploads.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Creates a single upload part, potentially using seekable or non-seekable streams, and adds necessary headers and parameters.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Extracts the ETag header from a multipart upload result.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of the source based on its filename.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the data source to be uploaded.

methods.name: decorateWithHashes
methods.description: Wraps a stream with a SHA256 hashing layer, storing the hash result in the data array.
